new_libraries.name: CS123x
new_libraries.author: FMazz97
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino library for Chipsea CS1237 and CS1238 24-bit ADCs (load cells, weight scales).
new_libraries.paragraph: Precision driver for Chipsea CS1237/CS1238 24-bit ADCs used in weight scales and bridge sensors. Features configurable PGA gain, data rates, channel selection, tare, scale calibration, and internal temperature sensing.
